meta.title: Aomark Listings network legacy basename upgrade QA
meta.description: Verifies the exact 3.5.1 to 3.5.3 main-filename migration for a network-activated plugin.
meta.author: aomark

steps.code: <?php $hashes = [ 'old' => hash_file( 'sha256', '/tmp/aomark-old/aomark-listings-3.5.1-wporg-final-20260731.zip' ), 'new' => hash_file( 'sha256', '/tmp/aomark-new/aomark-listings.zip' ) ]; if ( ! hash_equals( '0181d246cf09cb6a56abe1e74bc3936ec896008d8800417e76d1b92bcb80b20e', (string) $hashes['old'] ) || ! hash_equals( '04d3aed041160c68ea958ed92de1c5ad4ce06467031f5d867ec2a2900146c0f8', (string) $hashes['new'] ) ) { throw new RuntimeException( 'Exact ZIP checksum precondition failed: ' . json_encode( $hashes ) ); }

<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php'; $result = activate_plugin( 'aomark-listings/aomark-real-estate.php', '', true, true ); $active = array_keys( (array) get_site_option( 'active_sitewide_plugins', [] ) ); $models = get_option( 'aomark_listings_models', '__aomark_listings_missing__' ); if ( ! is_array( $models ) && function_exists( 'aomark_listings_default_models' ) ) { $models = aomark_listings_default_models(); update_option( 'aomark_listings_models', $models, false ); } $checks = [ 'activation' => ! is_wp_error( $result ), 'version' => defined( 'AOMARK_LISTINGS_VERSION' ) && '3.5.1' === AOMARK_LISTINGS_VERSION, 'legacy_active' => in_array( 'aomark-listings/aomark-real-estate.php', $active, true ), 'models_array' => is_array( $models ) && ! empty( $models ) ]; if ( in_array( false, $checks, true ) ) { throw new RuntimeException( 'Exact 3.5.1 network activation precondition failed: ' . wp_json_encode( $checks ) ); } update_option( 'aomark_listings_legacy_models_hash', hash( 'sha256', maybe_serialize( $models ) ), false );
